items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: She was a lovely lady by the way, Monk, she was a very, very warm, very fine lady. And we had some good times on the set

ctx.x: Yeah. She was a lovely lady by the way, Monk, she was a very, very warm, very fine lady. And we had some good times on the set with Buck Clayton, Ziggy Elman, Harry James. These guys are not around anymore.
Yeah. Well you’ve certainly brought some good cheer to many, many people over the years.
